title: Obama returns to the campaign trail amid GOP redistricting and fundraising advantage
text:
Former President Barack Obama is returning to the campaign trail almost two months before November’s midterm elections for a fundraising event at a time when President Donald Trump and his political advisers are unloading their deep coffers and making a mark on competitive contests.

Obama is headlining a fundraiser on Martha’s Vineyard, Massachusetts, on Monday for his former Attorney General Eric Holder’s organization, the National Democratic Redistricting Committee, after Republicans netted at least 10 additional GOP-leaning congressional districts through early redistricting.
